summary: Niki BioSolutions filed a Form 8-K under Items 8.01 and 9.01 to furnish its corporate PowerPoint presentation, given at the H.C. Wainwright Global Investment Conference in September 2026, as Exhibit 99.1. The filing discloses a name change from Aptorum Group Limited, a Princeton, New Jersey address, and references DiamiR Biosciences Corp. No transaction, stake, price, premium, board recommendation, advisor, or regulatory clock is stated. It is an informational disclosure only, not an offer to sell securities. No special-situation or risk-arb angle arises; watch for future strategic or financing announcements.
